_comment: Finalized in Phase 1 (Data Architecture) — Prompt 001. Deck composition below is now verified against the actual data/cards.json (60 cards, generated and asserted in Prompt 001), not just a placeholder.

initialLostLoot.rule: one value-2 card from each of the 9 non-Gold-Coin types, plus one Gold Coin value-4 card

abilities._comment: All abilities are implemented together in Stage A (see docs/phases/mvp-roadmap.md) - card abilities are core gameplay, not a deferred layer. The single/chain split below reflects the Resolution Queue implementation detail (GDD §12/§13), not build order.

assets._comment: Controls how card/UI icons resolve. See data/iconMap.json and js/iconManager.js. Switching 'emoji' -> 'image' requires editing data only, never code (data-driven rule, GDD §2.3).
